purpose: Vocabulary of cross-document relationships for future reasoning. NOT implemented as a graph in Phase G; this is the definition layer Phase H metadata may reference and later infrastructure may implement.

relationships.definition: two records describe one financial event (e.g. webhook retry, duplicate bank row)
relationships.evidence_required: identical amount+party+date or provider event id

relationships.definition: record is an accidental repetition of another
record cites another by identifier (invoice no., txn id)
relationships.conflict: id exists but amounts differ => contradicts

relationships.definition: payment record discharges part or all of an obligation record (invoice/bill)
relationships.future_infrastructure: balance context in dataset metadata only

relationships.definition: delivery record satisfies an order record (GRN -> PO)
relationships.future_infrastructure: document-context metadata (Phase H+); no graph in Phase G

relationships.definition: document provides evidence for another's claim (receipt backs expense)
records assert incompatible facts (cash vs cheque; two amounts)
record computed/produced from another (FX-converted amount, ledger entry from narration)
later record replaces an earlier one (corrected invoice, reversal)
relationships.evidence_required: explicit correction language or credit-note linkage

principle: relationships live in dataset METADATA and future infrastructure; the 18-field IR carries only what its locked fields already represent (references, ambiguity_flags, referenced_* fields)
